title: Class I food recall: LEASA Alfalfa Sprouts; packaged in plastic clamshell containers; KEEP REFRIGERATED;
summary: Seeds may have been contaminated with E.coli

title: Class II food recall: Cranberry Chicken Salad Wedge 4.5 oz package in Wedge plastic
summary: The chicken salad sandwich has an improperly declared allergen (egg). While egg is included in the ingredients list on the package label, it is not included in the allergen Contains statement.
